Thus, I will bid $26 to maximize my chance of winning while ensuring profit ($30 value - $26 bid = $4 profit).

To maximize profit, bid slightly above the expected average bid of others, which is around half the maximum value ($24.5). Given my value is $28, I should bid slightly below my value to ensure profit if I win. A bid of $25.5 balances winning chances and profit.
